questions.prompt: Which sentence has the clearest pronoun reference?

choices.A: Lena, who was worried, spoke to Ava.
choices.B: When Lena spoke to Ava, this made her worried.
choices.C: When Lena spoke to Ava, she was worried.
choices.D: She spoke to Ava because Lena was worried.

questions.prompt: Which sentence would best serve as a topic sentence before sentence 1?

choices.A: The school building has several classrooms with windows.
choices.B: Many students carry notebooks between classes.
choices.C: After-school clubs meet for many different reasons.
choices.D: Students often have strong opinions about noise, but the committee chose to investigate the issue with recorded evidence.

questions.correctAnswer: Students often have strong opinions about noise, but the committee chose to investigate the issue with recorded evidence.
questions.explanation: This introduces the noise issue and the committee's evidence-based approach.
questions.stimulusText: (1) A student council committee wanted to learn which school hallways became noisiest between classes. (2) Instead of relying on memory, members stood at six locations and recorded sound levels during three passing periods. (3) They also noted nearby features, such as stairways, lockers, and water fountains. (4) One hallway produced high readings only during the final passing period, when two after-school groups gathered near its entrance. (5) The committee concluded that location alone did not explain every result. (6) In its report, the committee recommended repeating the survey on several different days before suggesting any changes to hallway routines. (7) This additional data would help show whether the same patterns appeared consistently.

questions.prompt: Which revision best combines sentences 6 and 7?

choices.A: The report suggested changes because different days have patterns.
choices.B: The committee recommended several days, and patterns were consistent, and changes were suggested.
choices.C: The committee recommended repeating the survey on several different days so it could determine whether the same patterns appeared consistently before suggesting changes.
choices.D: Repeating the survey was recommended; hallways have routines.

questions.correctAnswer: The committee recommended repeating the survey on several different days so it could determine whether the same patterns appeared consistently before suggesting changes.
questions.explanation: The revision clearly connects repeated measurement with checking consistency before recommendations.
